summary: The Charles Schwab Corporation filed a prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a registered public offering of $1 billion 4.744% fixed-to-floating senior notes due 2030 and $1.25 billion 5.493% fixed-to-floating senior notes due 2037. The notes are senior unsecured obligations. Proceeds to CSC total $2.241875 billion after underwriting discounts of $8.125 million. Joint book-running managers include BofA, Citigroup, Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan, and Wells Fargo. Settlement is expected May 21, 2026. This is a routine debt offering with no special situation elements.
